prefs.notes: Source of truth (ARMSX3 is built on the ARMSX2 app, so the file keeps that name). config.global = one JSON object with every setting (ps3* keys for RPCS3, plus inert PS2-era keys such as eeCycleRate, mtvu, upscale tweaks that the PS3 core ignores, except upscaleFloat/renderer/customDriverId/fpsLimit/frameLimitEnable/aspectRatio/audioVolume/audioMuted which ARE used). config.game.<SERIAL> = sparse per-game JSON. config.coreOverrides and config.coreOverrides.game.<SERIAL> = JSON objects mapping 'Section@@Key' (RPCS3 YAML path joined with @@) to a YAML scalar string; these are replayed after the settings above, so they win, and they can set ANY RPCS3 key. configDb.ignore.<SERIAL> = JSON array of config_db keys the user switched off. Mode 660; keep the file's owner (the app uid) and mode when writing.

core_yaml.notes: RPCS3 global config written by the native core from the values ARMSX3 pushes with settingsSet at each boot/settings change. Do not edit: overwritten from prefs. Read it to see what the last session actually ran with (on the test device it matched config.global, e.g. Resolution, Resolution Scale, Shader Mode).

config_db.notes: Community per-game configs downloaded from https://api.rpcs3.net/config/?api=v1 (2288 titles when checked) plus ~60 built-in ARMSX3 fixes merged in (d41.a). The whole folder is deleted and rewritten on every database refresh, so hand edits are lost; it moves to config_db_off/ when the feature is disabled (pref configDb.enabled). Keys the user overrides per game are listed in config/config_db_user/<SERIAL>.keys so the DB does not override them.

per_game.game_id: PS3 title serial (four letters and five digits, e.g. BLUS3xxxx), from gamesCache in ARMSX2.xml. Also the folder names under config/dev_hdd0/game and the disc-icons/<SERIAL>.png files.
per_game.notes: Two per-game layers, both in ARMSX2.xml: (1) config.game.{game} = sparse JSON object with the same keys as config.global (e.g. {renderer: vulkan, customDriverId: <driver id>}); merge is per key, game value if present else global. (2) config.coreOverrides.game.{game} = JSON map of 'Section@@Key' -> YAML scalar string for any RPCS3 key; replayed after the global config.coreOverrides. Create either entry as a <string> holding {} if missing. Order at boot (k07.c): merged global+game JSON pushed with settingsSet, then Vblank Rate 60 and GETLLAR 100 forced, then built-in hard-coded game fixes (xt2), then coreOverrides global+game (pa1.h), then config_db_user/<SERIAL>.keys rewritten. The community config_db/<SERIAL>.yml is also applied for the game except keys listed in configDb.ignore.<SERIAL> or in config_db_user/<SERIAL>.keys (order relative to the settingsSet pushes not traced). Removing a key returns it to global.

renderer.label: Settings > Renderer (Graphics API)
renderer.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Video/Renderer. Mapping (ym6.f): opengl/gl/gles/angle -> OpenGL, null/none -> Null, anything else (auto, vulkan, software) -> Vulkan.

gpu_driver.label: Backend > GPU Driver
gpu_driver.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML (none: passed to native setCustomDriver). Directory name under /data/data/com.armsx3/files/drivers/; "" = system driver. Only used by the Vulkan renderer.

resolution_scale.label: Renderer > Internal Resolution
resolution_scale.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Video/Resolution Scale (= value x 100, clamped 25-800). The legacy key ps3ResolutionScale (int) is saved but NOT applied; the boot code uses upscaleFloat. 1 -> YAML Resolution Scale: 100 (verified on the test device).

ps3_output_resolution.label: Renderer > PS3 Output Resolution
ps3_output_resolution.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Video/Resolution. Index into the list shown. 2 -> 1280x720 (verified in config.yml on the test device). Most games only accept 720p/1080p/480p.

frame_limit.label: Performance > Display FPS Cap

values.45: Any other N: Frame limit Off + Second Frame Limit = N

frame_limit.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Video/Frame limit (+ Video/Second Frame Limit). Clamped -1..1000. 30/50/60/120 map to the named RPCS3 values; other positive numbers set Frame limit: Off and Second Frame Limit: N. frameLimitEnable=false overrides this with Frame limit: Off. 0 -> Auto (verified on the test device).

frame_limit_enable.label: Performance > Frame limiter
frame_limit_enable.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Video/Frame limit.

shader_mode.label: Renderer > Shader Mode
shader_mode.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Video/Shader Mode. 1 verified on the test device.

msaa.label: Renderer > MSAA
msaa.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Video/MSAA.

anisotropic_filter.label: Renderer > Anisotropic Filtering
anisotropic_filter.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Video/Anisotropic Filter Override. Clamped 0-16.

aspect_ratio.label: Renderer > Screen Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Video/Stretch To Display Area + Video/Aspect ratio. 0 -> Stretch true; 2 -> 4:3; any other value (1, 3-8) -> 16:9. Shared with the PS2-era aspect enum, so values 3-8 exist in the UI code but all mean 16:9 for PS3.

write_color_buffers.label: Renderer > Write Color Buffers
write_color_buffers.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Video/Write Color Buffers.

read_color_buffers.label: Renderer > Read Color Buffers
read_color_buffers.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Video/Read Color Buffers.

write_depth_buffer.label: Renderer > Write Depth Buffer
write_depth_buffer.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Video/Write Depth Buffer.

read_depth_buffer.label: Renderer > Read Depth Buffer
read_depth_buffer.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Video/Read Depth Buffer.

strict_rendering.label: Renderer > Strict Rendering Mode
strict_rendering.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Video/Strict Rendering Mode.

multithreaded_rsx.label: Renderer > Multithreaded RSX
multithreaded_rsx.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Video/Multithreaded RSX.

disable_zcull.label: Renderer > Disable ZCull Occlusion Queries
disable_zcull.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Video/Disable ZCull Occlusion Queries.

relaxed_zcull.label: Renderer > Relaxed ZCULL Sync
relaxed_zcull.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Video/Relaxed ZCULL Sync.

gpu_texture_scaling.label: Renderer > GPU texture scaling
gpu_texture_scaling.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Video/Use GPU texture scaling.

force_cpu_blit.label: Renderer > Force CPU Blit
force_cpu_blit.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Video/Force CPU Blit.

blending.label: Renderer > Blending
blending.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Video/Disable Hardware Blending + Video/Disable Programmable Blending.

vram_limit_mb.label: Renderer > VRAM Allocation Limit
vram_limit_mb.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Video/Vulkan/VRAM allocation limit (MB). Clamped 256-65536.

async_texture_streaming.label: Renderer > Asynchronous Texture Streaming
async_texture_streaming.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Video/Vulkan/Asynchronous Texture Streaming.

shader_compiler_threads.label: Renderer > Shader Compiler Threads
shader_compiler_threads.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Video/Shader Compiler Threads. Clamped 0-16.

texture_lod_bias.label: Renderer > Texture LOD Bias
texture_lod_bias.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Video/Texture LOD Bias Addend. Clamped -16..16.

frame_generation.label: Frame Generation
frame_generation.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Video/Frame Generation. The Play Store build says frame generation is only in the GitHub build.

gpu_turbo.label: Renderer > GPU Turbo (Adreno)
gpu_turbo.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML (native setGpuTurbo).

ppu_decoder.label: PS3 CPU > PPU Decoder
ppu_decoder.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Core/PPU Decoder.

spu_decoder.label: PS3 CPU > SPU Decoder
spu_decoder.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Core/SPU Decoder.

spu_block_size.label: PS3 CPU > SPU Block Size
spu_block_size.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Core/SPU Block Size.

ppu_threads.label: PS3 CPU > PPU Threads
ppu_threads.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Core/PPU Threads. Clamped 1-8.

llvm_threads.label: PS3 CPU > Max LLVM Compile Threads
llvm_threads.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Core/Max LLVM Compile Threads.

preferred_spu_threads.label: PS3 CPU > Preferred SPU Threads
preferred_spu_threads.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Core/Preferred SPU Threads. Clamped 0-6.

max_spurs_threads.label: PS3 CPU > Max SPURS Threads
max_spurs_threads.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Core/Max SPURS Threads. Clamped 1-6.

spu_loop_detection.label: PS3 CPU > SPU Loop Detection
spu_loop_detection.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Core/SPU loop detection.

spu_cache.label: PS3 CPU > SPU Cache
spu_cache.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Core/SPU Cache.

llvm_precompile.label: PS3 CPU > LLVM Precompilation
llvm_precompile.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Core/LLVM Precompilation.

accurate_spu_dma.label: PS3 CPU > Accurate SPU DMA
accurate_spu_dma.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Core/Accurate SPU DMA.

clocks_scale.label: PS3 CPU > Emulated Clock Speed
clocks_scale.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Core/Clocks scale. Clamped 10-3000.

thread_scheduler.label: PS3 CPU > Thread Scheduler
thread_scheduler.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Core/Thread Scheduler Mode. JSON key affinityMode is serialised from the scheduler field (k07 line 3054) and pushed as Core/Thread Scheduler Mode. Order of values follows the UI labels (perf.scheduler.os/rpcs3/rpcs3Alt); 0 = Operating System matched config.yml on the test device. Values 1/2 not tested.

spu_xfloat_accuracy.label: Advanced > SPU Float Accuracy
spu_xfloat_accuracy.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Core/SPU XFloat Accuracy.

accurate_spu_reservations.label: Advanced > Accurate SPU Reservations
accurate_spu_reservations.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Core/Accurate SPU Reservations.

accurate_rsx_reservations.label: Advanced > Accurate RSX Reservation Access
accurate_rsx_reservations.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Core/Accurate RSX reservation access.

accurate_cache_line_stores.label: Advanced > Accurate Cache Line Stores
accurate_cache_line_stores.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Core/Accurate Cache Line Stores.

ppu_nan_handling.label: Advanced > PPU Vector NaN Handling
ppu_nan_handling.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Core/PPU Vector NaN Handling.

accurate_dfma.label: Advanced > Accurate DFMA
accurate_dfma.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Core/Use Accurate DFMA.

sleep_timers.label: Advanced > Sleep Timers Accuracy
sleep_timers.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Core/Sleep Timers Accuracy.

perf_overlay.label: Overlay > Performance Overlay
perf_overlay.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Video/Performance Overlay/Enabled. The in-game quick menu can also toggle the overlay for the session (lv4.l); the boot value comes from this key.

perf_overlay_detail.label: Overlay > Detail Level
perf_overlay_detail.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Video/Performance Overlay/Detail level.

perf_overlay_position.label: Overlay > Position
perf_overlay_position.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Video/Performance Overlay/Position.

audio_backend.label: Audio > Audio Backend
audio_backend.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Audio/Renderer. Use Oboe (4) or Cubeb (2) on Android.

audio_buffering.label: Audio > Audio Buffer
audio_buffering.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Audio/Enable Buffering.

audio_buffer_ms.label: Audio > Audio Buffer (ms)
audio_buffer_ms.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Audio/Desired Audio Buffer Duration. Clamped 4-250.

audio_time_stretch.label: Audio > Time Stretching
audio_time_stretch.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Audio/Enable Time Stretching.

audio_format.label: Audio > Audio Format
audio_format.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Audio/Audio Format.

audio_volume.label: Audio > Volume
audio_volume.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Audio/Master Volume. Clamped 0-200. audioMuted=true forces Master Volume 0.

audio_muted.label: Audio > Mute
audio_muted.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML Audio/Master Volume = 0.

console_language.label: Advanced > Console Language
console_language.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML System/Language.

console_region.label: Advanced > Console Region
console_region.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML System/License Area.

enter_button.label: System > Enter button
enter_button.notes: Applied at game boot as RPCS3 YAML System/Enter button assignment.

shader_precision.label: (no UI: raw core override)
shader_precision.notes: Raw RPCS3 override map (see per_game.notes). The value is a JSON string holding a YAML scalar, so a string option keeps its own quotes: stored as "\"Low\"". An ARMSX3 migration can set it to Low. Per game: config.coreOverrides.game.{game}#Video@@Shader Precision.
